WITH metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') as jobs_discovered,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE applied_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') as applications_sent,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'interview' AND updated_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') as interviews_scheduled,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'offer') as offers_received,
    AVG(ai_score) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') as avg_ai_score,
    COUNT(DISTINCT source) as unique_sources
  FROM job_opportunities
),
conversion AS (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('interview', 'offer')) as responses,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'applied') as total_applied,
    ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('interview', 'offer'))::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'applied'), 0) * 100, 1) as response_rate
  FROM job_opportunities
  WHERE applied_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
),
top_sources AS (
  SELECT source, COUNT(*) as count, AVG(ai_score) as avg_score
  FROM job_opportunities
  WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
  GROUP BY source
  ORDER BY count DESC
  LIMIT 5
)
SELECT * FROM metrics, conversion

SELECT 
  source,
  COUNT(*) as applications,
  AVG(ai_score) as avg_score,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('interview', 'offer')) as responses,
  ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('interview', 'offer'))::numeric / COUNT(*) * 100, 1) as response_rate
FROM job_opportunities 
WHERE applied_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
GROUP BY source
ORDER BY response_rate DESC

WITH weekly_trend AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC('week', applied_at) as week,
    COUNT(*) as applications,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('interview', 'offer')) as responses
  FROM job_opportunities
  WHERE applied_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '8 weeks'
  GROUP BY week
  ORDER BY week
)
SELECT 
  week,
  applications,
  responses,
  LAG(applications) OVER (ORDER BY week) as prev_week_apps,
  LAG(responses) OVER (ORDER BY week) as prev_week_responses
FROM weekly_trend
